confounder_exclusion.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, geometry-based analyses show that several measured technical/acquisition/site factors are associated with the partition's geometry. Tissue source site has the largest association with candidate-generation consensus geometry (R-squared 0.345, q=0.0025) with no significant dispersion difference. CT phase (R-squared 0.154), CT slice thickness (0.136), CT z-spacing (0.142), and CT manufacturer (0.059) are associated with CT native-distance geometry; CT phase and CT manufacturer also show significant PERMDISP, so their PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion.
